scope: Independent source/equation and decision review only; no forecast, initialization, or admission outcome asserted.

source_and_build.note: Actual FIX source is linked by the instrumented build receipt; same-arm diagnostic and standard forecast output histories are byte-identical for hours 0–3. Historical prior policy pins the standard FIX compile/link lineage. Driver-object closure is not separately established by the historical source record.

checks.gamma_relation: PASS: mu=1 and cubic mass law give pidnr=(pi*rho_w/6)*Gamma(5)/Gamma(2)=4000*pi for rho_w=1000 kg m-3; KDM6 multiplies public QNRAIN by DEN and the same density cancels in the slope inversion. Public number is per model air mass, internal number per volume.
checks.source_constants: PASS: source mur=1, dmr=3, bvtr=0.8, avtr=841.9, lamdarmin=961, lamdarmax=35000 m-1, nrmax=5e7 m-3; source includes fall-speed and PREVP equations.
checks.admission: PASS: previous frozen evaluation plan specifies 11 B1 protection and 15 ORIGINAL recovery cells, all CSI comparisons individually >= with no averaging.

limits: Ratios describe unconstrained fixed-state gamma coefficients; model threshold branches, source caps, density, thermodynamics and coupling can change the actual response. PREVP is limited and coupled, so coefficient ratios are not actual evaporation ratios.

The two QR increment sums are point-weighted local algebraic quantities, not column mass, causal attribution, or a percentage. The opposite-sign H3_FA01 pattern precludes a universal timing explanation.
The chosen diameter is exploratory and neither observed nor optimized. The source check does not establish forecast skill, conservation, budget closure or operational suitability.

Before a six-hour forecast, verify candidate input changes only eligible QNRAIN, preserve other fields, and pass actual first-entry cap/PSD checks; a planning cap screen is not actual candidate-entry proof. The evaluator must use the unchanged 26 separately checked conditions.
